Service list (lustra / szkło 2-8 mm / szkło bezpieczne / szkło ornamentowe / szkło antywłamaniowe, the last partly hidden) and the stickers (BOOK TOURS, SELEKTA, HAKUNA TUNES, HELLO...) are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
